reviews.body: Thanks, this is a careful fix. Only the implicit `temperature=0` is dropped, and only next to `top_p` or thinking, which Anthropic rejects. An explicit temperature (per run, on `parameters`, or in settings) is still sent, and plain requests still get `temperature=0`. I checked that the default value stays 0, that clones keep it marked as unset, and that the new tests fail on `main` and pass here (provider suite: 73 passed). Merging.
